purpose: Diagnose recorded selection, entry gap and assumed friction separately; not another model or an engine promotion test
workflow: Verify current price lineage without LLM or changing buy pause
Run one frozen comparison on preserved non-protected records
Fix only reproducible implementation defects; do not retune failed strategies
Independent review, exact HEAD CI, merge and read-only deployment verification
population: All archived rows on each scheduled session; no current universe, outcome-based filtering or exclusion of 012510
selection: Archived BUY and STRONG_BUY labels only; not reconstructed current eight-factor inputs or executed bot picks
controls: Expected equal-weight K-name uniform selection from the same whole recorded date cohort
Expected equal-weight K-name nonselected control matched to selected counts in five trailing-volatility groups

risk_groups.unknown: kept in population; risk-matched comparison unavailable if any population member lacks the exact warmup

missing: Never drop missing future prices to improve control returns: incomplete whole cohort stays unknown; no interpolation or source-window extension
attribution: Archived close vs independently preserved KRX close disagreement inventory
Next-open-to-exit selected return vs whole-population and volatility-group controls
Unexecutable decision-close reference vs next-open return difference, with overnight gap stated separately
Same fixed cohort friction sensitivity; not a new account simulation
completion: A finite diagnostic result or a named input blocker; no extra parameter sweeps, fits, new source calls or failed-candidate reruns
inference: Report dates, unique selected tickers and overlapping horizons. No significance or independent verification claim from this short already-observed development interval
adoption: Never auto-adopt a trading change from this C-level short diagnostic. Positive relative returns alone are not costed executable profit or proof of current-engine superiority
